source_state: Actual selected isolated source plus explicitly selected main replay files; not a full main HEAD export.
limitations: Source hashes describe actual selected bytes, not their equality to every main HEAD file or every linked dependency.

Unrelated main working-tree bytes are not substituted for the selected compiler export. The exact 51 owned files agree across main, selected source and the successful gate; other compiler bytes are the actual selected export, not a claimed full-HEAD snapshot.
Scoped Git diff/status are raw byte streams and do not encode untracked contents; the source inventory contains the selected untracked files themselves.
Producer and SIMD plugin/tool binaries are fingerprinted, not included as a complete dynamic-loader dependency closure or reproducible-build attestation.

Build configuration and every historical validation attempt are archived verbatim. Only the two plan-selected build/test records must be green; failed/negative historical attempts remain failed, and no test is rerun here.
Freeze chronology must be checked against subsequent capture timestamps; no capture/replay or native benchmark is run here.
This records neither a quiescent/isolated host nor a calibrated timing model; user and system background CPU activity is outside this source freeze.

Native contiguous copy is an opt-in compiler realization, not a handwritten attention replacement. Transfer orientation, private interleaving and code/clone admission may change. Matched copy and specialization edges must independently verify equal snapshot capacity and bitwise outputs; across MMA choices capacity and reduction bits may change, with each arm checked against the independent FP64 reference; the source archive alone is not runtime evidence.
